scope_limit: CriticalAI Assurance is currently bounded to reviewing supplied high-impact AI requirements, risk controls, testing records, approvals, incident evidence and declared gaps for authorised human assurance review. It does not certify safety or compliance, approve deployment, accept risk, issue a regulator conclusion, or authorise external release.
review_pack_title: DIO CriticalAI Assurance Controlled Evidence Review Pack
human_gate_reason: Safety and compliance conclusions, deployment approval, risk acceptance, regulator conclusions, institutional attestations and final release remain with authorised humans and competent authorities.
